page.layout: Main page, one column of text at full width: italic lines at top, then the colophon, signature block and the catchword-like heading "LECTO." at right. No running head or page number. Right-hand printed page (partly visible, a fragment at the right edge, with text in columns and a decorative block) is cut off; only its edge fragments are visible and are not transcribed beyond the readable words.

p.i: tam tectamq; conservare, eamq; per-petuis admirabilem reddere victoriis clementer pergat.

main_text.p: Scripsi Franekerae, urbe Frisiorum & sede Academiae, Anno D. N. 1633.
main_text.head: LECTO.

page.notes: The right printed page is a fragment at the edge of the scan (partly visible text such as "LE", "BE", "Exio", "rè", "nar", "or", "Hadr. Iunii", "Compoli", "vocando", "Stephanus", "concinnatur", "Manuale hoc", "Pater b.m.", "quàm ut", "Testamenti", "sonarent", "ullam cau", "bus minuer", "Postremam") and is too cropped to transcribe reliably. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the middle of the page and was left out. The word "LECTO." is set in spaced capitals and may be a heading or a catchword; it is treated here as a heading.
